from pathlib import Path
import json,time
import z3
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
R,D,T,C,G,H=z3.Ints('alreadyRecovered futureDamage totalFutureHealing currentGap futureCapacityIncrease actualFutureHealing')
constraints=[R>=0,D>=0,T>=0,C>=0,G>=0,H>=0,H<=T,H<=D+C+G]
optimistic=R+z3.If(T<=C+G,T,C+G)
rows=[]
for divisor in [1,5,536870911]:
 solver=z3.Solver();solver.add(*constraints)
 actual=D-(R+H)/divisor;lower=-optimistic/divisor
 # Python unary minus is outside the nonnegative quotient used in production.
 lower=-(optimistic/divisor)
 solver.add(actual<lower)
 started=time.perf_counter();answer=solver.check()
 row={'divisor':divisor,'result':str(answer),'seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'formula':'D-floor((R+H)/k) >= -floor((R+min(T,C+G))/k)'}
 if answer!=z3.unsat:
  row['counterexample']=str(solver.model()) if answer==z3.sat else solver.reason_unknown()
 rows.append(row)
 if answer!=z3.unsat:raise AssertionError(row)
# Same unknown/capacity boundary as the runtime interface: this theorem does not infer T or G.
legacy=z3.Solver();legacy.add(*constraints,R==0,D==0,C==0,G==5,T==5,H==5)
legacy.add(D-(R+H)<-(R+z3.If(C<T,C,T)))
answer=legacy.check();assert answer==z3.sat
counter={str(v):legacy.model()[v].as_long() for v in [R,D,T,C,G,H]}
# Integer amount truncation and HP ceiling can only lower actual gain below a nonnegative ceil allowance.
amount,before,limit=z3.Ints('amount before limit')
cap=z3.Solver();cap.add(amount>=0,before>=1,limit>=before)
actualGain=z3.If(before+amount<=limit,amount,limit-before)
cap.add(z3.Or(actualGain<0,actualGain>amount));capResult=cap.check();assert capResult==z3.unsat
result={'z3Version':z3.get_version_string(),'assumptions':[str(x) for x in constraints],'proofs':rows,'legacyCapacityCounterexample':counter,'gainCapProof':str(capResult),'wholeSourceCertificate':False,'nativeSemanticsProvedBySolver':False,'limitations':['T must cover every legal future heal including max-HP-triggered healing','G must cover every possible increase of health capacity','No inference about callback closure, source reachability, potion quotas, death saves, scoring or finite Beam','Native integer HP and policy rounding only; fractional requested amounts are conservatively ceiled before this theorem']}
(p/'symbolic-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
